items.title: Clamped E3 committed-selection variance-MONOPOLY PRESENCE audit in V3-EXQ-571's own config (clamp OFF vs ON, matched seeds)
items.note: MONOPOLY-PRESENCE AUDIT, ratified 2026-08-30 governance (REE_assembly 54dbe477be) off confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-936a_2026-08-30 (b0c0b8df72) Section 8. GATES THE 936 FAMILY: a further 936-family falsifier is REFUSED until a monopoly-present regime is established. MECH-439's 0.886 premise comes from V3-EXQ-571 ARM_0 (2026-05-15/16), which ran BEFORE the E2 rollout clamp landed (ree-v3 d327b89, 2026-05-31) and with the flag at its default False; 936a then measured the inverse (residue ~99.9998%, F 6.33e-06) but in a DIFFERENT config, so neither run separates 'the clamp did it' from 'three months of substrate drift did it'. This makes the clamp a WITHIN-RUN, WITHIN-CONFIG manipulation (571's own config, clamp OFF vs ON, matched seeds), which a clamp-ON-only re-run could not do. Ha -> premise collapses, governance re-words; Hb -> MECH-439 is regime-scoped and the falsifier is re-posed THERE with a monopoly-presence precondition and a relative bar. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = per-channel committed-selection variance share in 571's config with the clamp armed. reanalysis_query over evidence/experiments found f_variance_share carried ONLY by v3_exq_936/936a (substrate_hash 8a497aea/2151a114, both the GAP-A stack, not 571's config); 571's own manifests predate substrate_hash entirely (UNVERIFIABLE) and are unclamped. Not recoverable -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-439 counts 13 ceiling autopsies, but this is a DIAGNOSTIC on the MEASUREMENT axis, which the 936a autopsy Section 8 explicitly exempted ('the successor is on the measurement axis, not another letter of the braked design'). No ceiling hit added. Carrying forward that autopsy's unresolved 9-vs-12 brake-count reconcile for GOV-APPLY-1 rather than silently picking a number -- it does not affect this reading either way. STEP 2.5c: open corrupting substrate_queue entries contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy and SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training overlap paths this driver exercises; both are fix-landed-pending-validation and both bear on representation/rollout QUALITY, whereas this readout is a channel-SCALE property of the score sum. Recorded as known limitations, not blocking. The other corrupting entries are unreachable here: use_lateral_pfc_analog / use_salience_coordinator / use_blocked_agency are all config-default False and this driver enables none of them. THREE PREDECESSOR INSTRUMENT DEFECTS FIXED, each confirmed against source not inferred: (1) 571 read the E3 decomp once per ENV STEP while e3_steps_per_tick defaults to 10 and the last_* attributes LATCH, so its ~200 rows sat behind ~20 real selections -- measured replication_factor 7.06 here; this driver latch-gates via _lib/fresh_select and records n_latched. (2) 571's component list (inherited by 936/936a) summed the RAW unweighted `f`, but the score is f_weight*f + lambda_eff*m + rho_residue*phi (e3_selector.py:1310), so the additive F term is `f_weighted`; harmless at the default f_weight=1.0 but silently wrong otherwise -- both component sets are now decomposed and recorded. (3) 936a's prescribed scale anchors were never implemented, leaving 'naturally sub-ceiling vs clamp-PINNED' unanswerable; measured read-only here off the committed rollout. DV-SYMMETRY (per arm, mandatory): DV is variance SHARES, whose symmetry group is per-channel additive constants, selection-index permutation, and a COMMON positive rescaling. A0/A1 (load-bearing CLAMP contrast) is NOT invariant -- the clamp bounds ||z_world|| along the rollout, rescaling the f/residue path non-uniformly, i.e. changing the RATIO of per-channel variances, and it demonstrably binds (smoke: max||z_w||/ceiling 183.2 unclamped vs exactly 1.0000 clamped). A2/A3 (secondary STACK contrast) reaches the DV only INDIRECTLY and is explicitly NOT load-bearing: the stack's bias is composed into score_bias at the select() call site, outside score_trajectory (e3_selector.py:1288-1296), benefit/novelty/goal_weighted are hardcoded 0.0 in the component dict, and a probe found last_channel_terms carrying a single score_bias entry with per-candidate range 0.0 -- a BROADCAST SCALAR, argmin-invariant by construction. No verdict routes on those arms. SMOKE: PASS end-to-end (8 cells), and it earned its keep -- it caught TWO defects before any compute. (a) the 571/936a pool share method divides by variance-of-the-SUM (covariance retained), so an anti-correlated pair drives the 'share' ABOVE 1.0 -- observed at 1.06 and 2.15 -- making '>=0.85' not a monopoly test; C1 now routes on the committed partition (sum-of-variances denominator, bounded [0,1]) with the pool figures still recorded and each >1 cell flagged. (b) the clamp anchor originally tested 'norm >= ceiling', which is TRUE both when a clamped rollout is pinned AT the ceiling and when an unclamped one EXCEEDS it -- it read 0.9667 on BOTH arms at seed 42, invariant under its own manipulation; split into at_ceiling / above_ceiling / max_over_ceiling, which now separate the arms cleanly. red-team (fable, CROSS-MODEL): CONTESTED, 4 findings, all dispositioned; a same-model opus-5 pass was also run in-session when fable's verdict was slow to arrive, and it independently reproduced fable's findings 2 and 3 (recorded because it shows the two passes converged, not as a substitute for the cross-model one). Fable verified the sound parts against source first: the clamp genuinely reaches the DV (e2_fast.py:698-712 anchors max_allowed_norm on the initial z_world, applied per step at :741-747, and world_states[0] IS that unclamped initial state at :687-689, so the ceiling arithmetic is right -- corroborated by the smoke's exact max/ceil==1.0000); per_candidate and selected_idx come from the same enumeration (e3_selector.py:2782-2814, :3938) so the committed read is aligned; the >1 pool pathology is correctly quarantined to a non-routing method. F1 (PRIMARY) FIXED-BY-MEASUREMENT: 936a -- the run where residue_weighted took ~99.9998% -- calls agent.update_residue() every step (936a driver:760); neither 571 nor this driver does (verified grep counts 0/0/1), so fable argued residue is structurally unable to hold the monopoly in EITHER arm here, meaning the run could not tell 'the clamp does not cause the residue inversion' from 'this driver starved the channel'. Verified against source and the reviewer's stated mechanism is INCOMPLETE -- residue_field.accumulate() is also reached from e3_selector.py:4083 whenever harm_occurred, and this config runs NUM_HAZARDS=1, so the path is live. Resolved by MEASURING rather than assuming either way: each cell now records residue_rbf_active_centers (active_mask.sum()), the summary exposes residue_rbf_active_centers_max and adjudicates_936a_residue_inversion, and the outcome_note appends a scope caveat generated FROM that measurement. Smoke measured 0 active centers, so on current evidence this run characterises the monopoly WITHIN 571's non-accumulating regime and explicitly does NOT adjudicate the 936a residue inversion -- the full-length run re-measures, since harm may recruit centers over 2000 steps. F2 FIXED: the readiness gate took the worst cell across ALL four arms while only A0/A1 route the verdict, so a secondary div-stack cell under-sampling would have vacated a clean load-bearing result -- the V3-EXQ-785 whole-run-AND defect. Preconditions are now scoped to the verdict-bearing arms; the secondary arms' readiness is recorded as a non-gating diagnostic. F3 FIXED: C1^C2^C3 all true collapsed to label 'f_monopoly_regime_present_clamped' while the smoke shows the occupant SHIFTING within F (f_weighted -> harm_weighted as the clamp annihilates the smoothness term's variance), hiding from governance that the 0.886 monopolist was destroyed and a same-bucket sibling inherited a 10^4-10^5x smaller residual pool. Added the distinct label f_monopoly_present_clamped_occupant_shifted. F4 FIXED: 571 passes seed=None (OS entropy per construction), so 'matched seeds' matched agent init but NOT world layout, leaving C3's per-seed pairing layout-confounded. The env seed is now derived from the run seed only and is arm-INDEPENDENT, so all four arms at a given seed share a layout and the clamp contrast is genuinely within-layout. Deviation from 571's unseeded default is deliberate and declared in the config slice (env_seed_base / env_seed_scheme). NOT FIXED, recorded: the routed committed partition and 571's covariance-retained 0.886 are different statistics and the 0.85 bar was calibrated in 571's world. The bar is deliberately left where 936a set it rather than re-derived, because moving a pre-registered threshold to fit a new statistic would fabricate it; compare 0.886 against legacy571_pool_top_share, never against C1 (stated in the manifest's diagnostics.share_method_note).

items.title: MECH-144 shuffle-inertness confirmer: why were V3-EXQ-966's arms behaviourally identical?
items.note: Cheap confirmer for V3-EXQ-966, run FIRST per the user's Step 8 ratification of confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_966-436g-951-959-822d-cluster_2026-08-30 (REE_assembly 40dd17331e; governance-ratified 54dbe477be) at 2026-08-30T15:41:56Z: 'the cheap confirmer runs FIRST -- one seed, blocks 3-4, both arms, logging amplitudes, agent_energy and per-step actions -- before any substrate work is specified or 966a is queued.' This entry does NOT redesign 966 and does NOT specify a substrate build. experiment_purpose=diagnostic, claim_ids=[] -- it localises an instrument, it tests no claim, and is excluded from governance confidence scoring. | STEP 2.4 (GOV-REUSE-1): decisive readout is the MATCHED-STEP divergence of agent_energy and of the committed action index between ARM_FIXED_VALUE and ARM_SHUFFLED_VALUE. Checked run v3_exq_966_mech143_144_hippocampal_value_sensitivity_causal_20260830T115037Z_v3 (substrate_hash 210a5c861e6113993e5f, 8 arm_results): its rows carry only block-level aggregates (block_contacts, frac_high_pre/post, n_contacts_pre/post, c1) and NO per-step trace, so the readout is neither recorded nor derivable -> run. | STEP 4.5 red-team (fable, run by predecessor session c1-queue-refill-20260901): CONTESTED with one BLOCKING -> all findings verified against source and APPLIED before queueing. BLOCKING: D2 compared distinct-benefit SETS and MEANS, which TIE under exact reproduction of 966's bit-identity (both arms visit both types, so each arm's set is {LOW,HIGH}), so the run would have emitted 'amplitude_not_reaching_consumption' and made the whole H-inert vs H-insensitive adjudication unreachable -- D2 is now MATCHED-STEP, aggregates retained as diagnostics. Reproduced live in this session's smoke: both arms report benefits=[0.045,0.3], i.e. the withdrawn aggregate form reads False exactly where the matched-step form reads True. HIGH: 966 trains e1+latent_stack for 12 P0 warmup episodes (Adam 3e-4, prediction + resource-encoder loss); this driver rolled the warmup with no optimiser (StepHarness train_mode only toggles the grad context), so its logged-block agent was untrained-encoder -- 966's P0 block is now replicated and a p0_warmup_actually_trained readiness precondition asserts it (smoke: 30 opt steps). MEDIUM: D1 and the applied benefit now read the LIVE env (env.resource_type_benefit_amplitudes) rather than driver constants. MEDIUM: energy divergence onset + extent recorded; C2_policy_responds is non-degenerate only when the post-divergence window clears MIN_POST_DIVERGENCE_STEPS=20, so H_insensitive_policy cannot fire off a near-zero exposure window. MINOR: per-cell verdict print keyed to MIN_LOGGED_CONTACTS; docstring cite :2131 -> :2133 (verified). | ADDITIONAL Step 3.5 finding by the queueing session, not from the red-team: D3 routes on agent_energy but nothing asserted a contact can MOVE agent_energy in this config, so a flat D3=False could have been an instrument artifact wearing the H_inert_in_fact substrate label. Added the contact_bump_reaches_agent_energy readiness precondition, which reconstructs contact_benefit from the observable channel alone and routes a dead channel to substrate_not_ready_requeue. Used as a LIVENESS FLOOR only -- it does not subtract the action/movement energy cost at causal_grid_world.py:2707, so its value is not a calibrated contact_benefit. Smoke reads bump_max=0.04 in BOTH arms, matching neither amplitude-derived benefit (0.3 / 0.045); if that survives the full run it is direct support for H_inert_in_fact_energy_route_blocked and is the first number to read. | DV-SYMMETRY (per arm, both arms share one DV set): the manipulation is a PERMUTATION of which resource type carries the HIGH amplitude. The DVs are (a) the per-step agent_energy trajectory, (b) the per-step committed action index, (c) PER-TYPE block_contacts. The manipulation is NOT invariant under any symmetry of these: (a) is amplitude-weighted, so a type permutation changes it whenever the two amplitudes differ (1.0 vs 0.15); (b) is compared step-matched, not as a set, so it is not a symmetric function of the type labels; (c) is reported per type and compared per type. Stated explicitly because the POOLED contact count IS invariant under the type permutation and frac_high is exactly antisymmetric under it -- that invariance is 966's original defect (frac_high_SHUFFLED = 1 - frac_high_FIXED by construction), and this driver deliberately reports none of those pooled/fractional forms. | Does NOT adjudicate chip-20260830-exq966-wantingweight-fromdims-dropsite: it sets wanting_weight via from_dims AND asserts the landed runtime value as a recorded precondition, so it is correct whichever way that chip resolves. Smoke PASS (structural; readiness correctly routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at dry-run length, which is expected and documented in ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT).
